years_experience.description: Total years of relevant work experience stated or computable from dates; null if not stated.

current_employer_type.description: Type of the current or most recent employer; 'none' for students/unemployed; null if unclear.

notice_period_days.description: Notice period in days if stated (30 per month); null if not stated.

expected_ctc_lpa.description: Expected compensation in INR lakh per annum if stated; null otherwise. Do not convert other currencies.

location.description: Current city/country if stated; null otherwise.

score.description: 0-3 per the rubric anchors; null = unknown, no evidence in the CV.

evidence.description: One verbatim quote copied exactly from the CV text that justifies the score; null when score is null.

summary.description: At most five short lines describing the candidate's fit, based only on the CV.

flags.description: Zero or more of: injection_attempt, keyword_stuffing, sparse_cv, inconsistent_dates, unverifiable_claims, notice_period_over_90d, location_mismatch, other:<short text>.
